name: execution-order-define-stages-and-loops
alt: The Define tab of Execution order in Hydra Studio Project settings: three stages with their mode, wait fields and workflows, an Add stage button, a Not in the thread list, and a Loops box with one loop.

name: execution-order-define-unsaved-change
alt: The Define tab after adding the cleanup workflow to the thread: the workflow joins the list and the Save button is enabled because the change is not saved yet.

name: execution-order-preview-diagram
alt: The Preview tab of Execution order: boxes for prepare, load_sales, load_stock and report from left to right, the two loads stacked, a one second wait marker and a dashed loop arrow.

name: execution-order-preview-wait-timeout-fallback
alt: The Preview tab of a thread with a wait before a workflow, a maximum duration and a fallback workflow shown as a dashed orange block below load_sales.

name: execution-order-check-ready-result
alt: The Execution order tab after pressing Check on a valid thread: a green line says Ready, then lists the workflows in order and the number of loops.

name: execution-order-check-errors-result
alt: The Execution order tab after pressing Check on a thread that names a missing workflow file and a missing fallback file: red lines give the exact messages.
